notes:
### Changes
- Fix first-pull gateway timeouts on large projects by always requesting metadata without file contents.
- Apply local ignore rules before downloading required file contents by immutable rowKey, using the existing limit of four concurrent requests.
- Preserve snapshot baselines, incremental synchronization, three-way merge and deferred worktree writes.

### Validation
- Build, TypeScript checks and package inspection passed.
- Local CLI diagnostics verified metadata-only initial listing, ignored-file exclusion, four concurrent downloads, incremental downloads and preservation of local edits.
